title: Practice 6: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Они там ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **едут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: Куда вы ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **едете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: Я ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.), отец!.
exercises.why: **еду** — present tense (1st person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) они сами.
exercises.why: **едут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: Как вы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **летаете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Пули ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) чаще.
exercises.why: **летают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) к вам?
exercises.why: **ходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) в нее?
exercises.why: **ходишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: А почему не ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.)?
exercises.why: **летают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Так не ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.)!
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Ко мне ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Но она ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.)?
exercises.why: **ходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Так ты ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **ходишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: В оперу ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **ходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Не ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., imper. pl.) туда.
exercises.why: **ходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Мало ли ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) жуков?
exercises.why: **летает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Пух ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) до вечера.
exercises.why: **летает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: А я все ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.) и все смеюсь.
exercises.why: **летаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: И все ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **ездят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Конечно, ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.), - ответил он.
exercises.why: **летаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
